text:
Brayden McNabb does the work nobody puts on a highlight reel, and Vegas has quietly built its blue line around it. He's at 19:48 a night this season, up to about 21 minutes over the last ten games, and the Golden Knights take 60% of the expected goals at five on five with him out there, 11 points better than when he sits.

He has no goals and eight assists, which is about right for a 35-year-old stay-at-home defenceman, and the range we'd expect from here is modest (about 26 points over a full season). The defending is the point. Evolving-Hockey had him taking away 0.17 expected goals per 60 last season after adjusting for everything around him, 91st percentile, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking has him stopping 16% of the entries aimed at him, against a typical 11%. He's one of the slowest skaters in the league by top speed and doesn't need to be fast. Watch how often opponents dump the puck into the other corner instead of challenging his side.
